intro: Experience the best of Reykjavík at EIR Complex
EIR is the newest addition to Heimaleiga’s collection, offering a calm and contemporary retreat just a short distance from Reykjavík’s vibrant center

Located beside the ocean, our modern apartments offer a stylish and peaceful retreat in one of the city’s most desirable neighborhoods. Just steps from Reykjavik’s iconic landmarks, each apartment is designed to combine comfort, functionality, and a touch of luxury for every traveller.

name: Ice Apartments

lede.en: Apartments at Laugavegur 1, where the main street begins.
lede.is: Íbúðir á Laugavegi 1, þar sem Laugavegurinn byrjar.

intro: Bright and comfortable apartments in a perfect location

The Ice Apartments are elegantly furnished, bright and spacious. Perfect for couples or families. Close proximity to shopping, museums, restaurants, grocery stores, car park and transportation. Each apartment includes a sofa bed, fully equipped modern kitchen, dining area, free wi-fi and bathroom with shower. Sleeping accommodations for up to four people. Some of the apartments come with a balcony, accessible from the bedroom.
Please note that this is a self check-in property.

name: 46heima Boutique Apartments
intro: Premium Apartments in Downtown Reykjavik

Experience ultimate comfort in our premium apartments, thoughtfully designed to make you feel right at home, even when you’re away. Perfect for couples and families, our studios accommodate 2-5 guests and come highly rated by our satisfied visitors. Enjoy the convenience of modern amenities, including free Wi-Fi, a fully-equipped kitchenette with a dishwasher, flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom with a shower. We also provide a fridge, stovetop, toaster, kettle, and coffee machine for your culinary needs. Plus, laundry facilities are available on-site for your convenience. Your perfect vacation home awaits!
Please note that this is a self check-in property.

name: Saga Studios

lede.en: Ten studios in a four-storey house on Barónsstígur, many with balconies.
lede.is: Tíu stúdíóíbúðir í fjögurra hæða húsi við Barónsstíg, margar með svölum.

intro: Discover the ultimate urban retreat at Saga Studios, in the heart of downtown Reykjavik.
Perfect for couples seeking a romantic getaway, our four-story building boasts 10 stylish and comfortable studios, many with private balconies.
Each unit features elegant parquet floors, a well-equipped kitchenette with a fridge, stovetop, and kettle, a cozy dining area, a flat-screen TV, and a sleek private bathroom with a shower.

Our prime location places you just a 1-minute stroll from the bustling Laugavegur shopping street, a 7-minute walk from the iconic Hallgrímskirkja Church, and 17 minutes from the stunning Harpa Music Hall. Experience modern comfort and convenience, making Saga Studios your perfect home away from home in Reykjavik.

name: TÝR Apartments

lede.en: Apartments on Grettisgata with a view over the city.
lede.is: Íbúðir við Grettisgötu með útsýni yfir borgina.

intro: Týr Apartments is perfect for your explorations while in Iceland.

The apartments have a city view and you can enjoy the downtown area comfortably by foot. Only a few steps away is the popular shopping street Laugavegur and the beautiful Hallgrímskirkja Church is only 5 minutes walk away. The area has plenty of restaurants in all ranges but you’re also free to make a homemade meal with the fully equipped kitchen.
Please note that this is a self check-in property.

name: B2 Apartments
intro: Discover the perfect getaway in Reykjavik with our modern B2 Apartments

Ideally situated near Hlemmur food hall & large bus station, and with a café next door. While staying in a more tranquil part of the city, the apartments offer easy access to the bustling main street, Laugavegur, ensuring you can enjoy the best of both worlds—peaceful relaxation and lively city life. Recently renovated, the apartment features a modern interior with stylish black and white decor, complemented by sleek wooden cabinets. Whether you’re exploring city life by foot or embarking on an Icelandic adventure by car, B2 provides the perfect home base.
Please note that this is a self check-in property.

name: Frost Apartments
intro: Frost Apartments offer a cozy retreat in central Reykjavik

Located in a more quiet part of downtown, yet close to Laugavegur’s shops and restaurants, our studio apartments accommodate 2-4 guests. Nearby attractions include Reykjavik Art Museum Kjarvalsstadir, the historical house “Höfði”, Hlemmur foodhall, a public park and a swimming pool. With essential services and public transport within easy reach, Frost Apartments ensure a convenient and enjoyable stay.
Please note that this is a self check-in property.

Located in a peaceful area just minutes from the city’s iconic landmarks, our modern apartments offer a comfortable and stylish retreat for every traveler.
Each apartment is designed with comfort and convenience in mind.

intro: Situated in Kópavogur, a mere 20-minute drive from downtown Reykjavik, Icelandic Apartments presents guests with a haven of comfort.

Our accommodations feature well-appointed apartments offering complimentary Wi-Fi, inviting living spaces, and fully equipped kitchens. Each room comes complete with a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom featuring a shower. Certain apartments afford stunning vistas, overlooking the serene Lake Ellidavatn and the majestic Blue Mountains (Bláfjöll). Who knows if you’ll see some aurora over the peaks of Bláfjöll while staying with us.
Please note that this is a self check-in property.

name: Amtmann Residence

lede.en: In Selfoss, a gateway to the South Coast and the Golden Circle.
lede.is: Á Selfossi, við hlið Suðurlands og Gullna hringsins.

intro: Situated in the heart of Selfoss, a gateway to Iceland's South Coast and the Golden Circle, Amtmann Residence offers guests a spacious and sophisticated base for exploring the region.

Our residence offers a range of apartments – from two-bedroom units to spacious penthouses – perfectly designed for couples, families, or groups. Each apartment features a bright and inviting living area, a fully equipped kitchen, and well-appointed bathrooms for your comfort. Every stay includes high-speed wireless internet, making it easy to stay connected during your travels. From here, you’re within easy reach of world-famous waterfalls and natural wonders along the Ring Road, as well as peaceful riverside walks right outside your door.
Please note that this is a self check-in property.
